page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head "DE GEMMIS" at the top, page number "41" at the top right. Catchword "D" at the foot right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Eftq; aut grandis minusq; politus, ut Tophus, & Marmor : aut minutus maximeq; politus, ut Gemma.
Gemma alia eft pellucida, alia non.

Minus clare, quae colore aliquo obscuriore prę-ditę funt:ut Smaragdus viridis : Sapphirus ceruleus: Sardonyx mixto colore ex albo & rubeo, qualis eft unguium digitorum humanorum : Aphrofelenus deniq; inftar vitri denfioris pellucens; major tamen fulgidiorque exfiftit Luna crefcente, quàm decrefcente.
Non-pellucida gemma vel eft colorata tantùm, vel colorata fimul & lucens.
Colorata tantùm, alia unicolor, alia varicolor.

unicolor : ut Asbestus & Magnes, nigrescentes: Galastites[?], coloris lactei: Corallium, cùm rubrum, tum album, tum nigrum. (Quanquam Corallium non in terris, sed in certis maribus crescat, indeq; extractum ad pulcrae gemmae similitudinem lapidescat.)

Varicolor:ut Chrysoprasus in viridi colore aureis maculis confperfus ;Jaspis rubeis ; Orites, albis ; Turcois ceruleis : Hæmatites sanguineis venulis in ferrugineo colore: Achates variarum rerum imagines coloratas exhibens : &c.
Colorata simul & lucens gemma, aut clariore luce fulget, aut minùs clara.
Prioris generis funt: Carbunculus, gemma rubea,

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. "Galastites" is doubtful (printed Galastites; expected Galactites), marked [?]. "Turcois" and "Quanquam" copied as printed. Italic and roman distinctions in some lines (e.g. "gemma vel eft", "unicolor") are approximate. A small mark near the foot ("D" with a tiny symbol beside it) is treated as the catchword only. Bottom-left library stamp omitted.
